system.description:
You manifest an emerald-colored flame and mark a creature you can see within range with it. The target creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, being marked by the emerald flame on failure.

A marked creature, for the duration that fails a saving throw against a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword gains a rank of Shaken.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can attempt to mark up to 3 creatures instead of 1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, this jutsu’s range instead becomes Self(45-Radius) forcing all creatures of your choice to be affected by this jutsu.
